subject: executor: make tablesample work under different partition prune modes (#52405)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff (vs first parent) focused on planner/executor changes for `TABLESAMPLE REGIONS()` on partitioned tables under static vs dynamic partition prune modes. Planner now propagates `DataSource.physicalTableID` into `PhysicalTableSample.PhysicalTableID` (`pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go`, `pkg/planner/core/physical_plans.go`), and executor range splitting uses `GetPartitionedTable()` plus that physical ID to sample either all partitions (dynamic/whole-table ID) or a single partition (static/partition child ID) (`pkg/executor/sample.go`), avoiding duplicated sampling under static pruning; executor builder wires the new field through (`pkg/executor/builder.go`). No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/consistency/compatibility/concurrency/privilege/session/transaction handling for this diff.
